_what: Google Play's target API level requirement, as read from https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/11926878 (scripts/check_target_api.py reads this; the owner re-reads the page and updates it at least every 180 days: docs/m12/maintenance-runbook.md §3.3). Dates are the day the rule applies to new apps and to updates of existing apps; extension_until is the latest date Google grants on request in Play Console; the script fails after new_apps_and_updates_from unless the rule has "extension_granted": true — set by the owner when Play Console confirms the extension (docs/m12/maintenance-runbook.md §3.3) — in which case it warns until extension_until; expected_next is Google's pattern for the year after the last listed rule and must be moved up when that rule is added.

expected_next.note: Google's pattern: the API of the Android released in the year, required from 31 August of the next year; a guess until the page says so, used only for the warning's lead time
